aspect: No monetary policy, because no currency
description: The Palestine Monetary Authority is not a central bank in the usual sense. There is no rate to set, no currency to devalue, and inflation is imported wholesale from another economy.
energy_note: An economy with no steering wheel.

aspect: Clearance revenues are collected by the other side
description: Import duties and VAT on goods entering for the Palestinian market are collected by Israel and transferred to the PA - and periodically withheld, at which point public salaries are paid at a fraction.
money_note: Household effect of a partial salary month.
energy_note: Your salary depends on a political decision elsewhere.

aspect: Partial salaries land on households, mostly on women
description: When public sector pay arrives at 60% or 70%, the household budget is rebuilt by whoever runs it - cutting food, deferring medicine, borrowing from family - which is generally the woman.
energy_note: Told in the morning that this month is sixty per cent.
